summary: Reports on the second Coordinating Attack Response at Internet Scale (CARIS) workshop, sponsored by the Internet Society and held in Cambridge, Massachusetts in early 2019. Participants from incident response teams, operators, and service providers discussed how to coordinate responses to large-scale attacks. It is a workshop report, not a protocol specification.

eli5.summary: Experts who defend the Internet from attacks met to talk about how to team up faster, and this is the written record of what they discussed.
